build-and-tag-image:
	docker build --build-arg http_proxy=$$http_proxy \
		--build-arg https_proxy=$$https_proxy \
		--build-arg no_proxy=$$no_proxy \
		--build-arg HTTP_PROXY=$$HTTP_PROXY \
		--build-arg HTTPS_PROXY=$$HTTPS_PROXY \
		--build-arg NO_PROXY=$$NO_PROXY \
		--no-cache .
		
#		--progress plain 

build-and-save-image:
	make build-and-tag-image
	docker image save blp-streamlit-pipeline:latest | gzip > blp-streamlit-pipeline.tar.gz

run:
	docker compose -f deployment/docker-compose.yml up --build

local-run:
	poetry lock
	poetry install
	cd blp_streamlit_pipeline && poetry run python -m streamlit run run.py----
docker-compose.yml
----
services:
  streamlit-pipeline:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      args:
        http_proxy: ${http_proxy}
        https_proxy: ${https_proxy}
        no_proxy: ${no_proxy}
        HTTP_PROXY: ${HTTP_PROXY}
        HTTPS_PROXY: ${HTTPS_PROXY}
        NO_PROXY: ${NO_PROXY}
      tags:
        - blp-streamlit-pipeline:latest
    image: blp-streamlit-pipeline:latest
    environment:
      HTTP_PROXY: ${HTTP_PROXY}
      HTTPS_PROXY: ${HTTPS_PROXY}
      NO_PROXY: ${NO_PROXY}
      http_proxy: ${http_proxy}
      https_proxy: ${https_proxy}
      no_proxy: ${no_proxy}
    ports:
      - 8501:8501
    networks:
      - default
    restart: unless-stopped
    develop:
      watch:
        # sync code (and restart) if changes were made in app
        - action: sync # +restart
          path: ../blp_streamlit_pipeline/
          target: /app/blp_streamlit_pipeline/
        # rebuild if dependencies changed or changes were made in deployment directory
        - action: rebuild
          path: .
        - action: rebuild
          path: ../poetry.lock
        - action: rebuild
          path: ../Makefile
        - action: rebuild
          path: ../Dockerfile

networks:
  default:
    driver: bridge

observation.command: cd /workspace && cat Makefile && echo ---- && ls deployment/ && echo ---- && cat deployment/docker-compose.yml
